questions.prompt: The same speaker appears in training and test sequences. What should change?
options: Split by source speaker before assembling sequences
questions.explanation: Splitting speakers first prevents the model from being tested on familiar voices hidden in new sequences.

questions.prompt: An identifier starts with 007. Which transcript should be retained?
questions.explanation: Leading zeros are part of the identifier. A text normalizer must not silently change the target.

questions.prompt: A short recording is padded to match a longer one. Which length belongs in CTC input_lengths?
questions.explanation: CTC needs the valid number of output frames for each example, excluding padding.
